name: Olla Taqueria Gutierrez
limitations: Official restaurant and Kentucky tourism information, plus a separately attributed public visitor comment; no on-site audit. The tourism listing calls the same location 302 W. MLK Jr Blvd. Entrance steps and thresholds, door controls, parking-to-door routes, table clearance, toilet/changing facilities and personal assistance remain unverified. Patio heating is an undated tourism description, not confirmation that the patio is open, heated or step-free on a particular day. A visitor’s impression of the atmosphere does not establish measured noise or present crowding.
facts: Kentucky Tourism lists patio dining and describes the patio as heated in winter. Confirm seasonal opening, heating and the route before visiting; this does not establish step-free patio access.
Patio dining (heated in the winter) is available.

Olla offers delivery and carryout ordering links. Its site says a 5% fee applies to to-go orders for compostable packaging; collection arrangements and any other charges need checking with the selected order.
Order Delivery or Carry Out Below
A 5% fee is applied to to-go orders to help offset the higher cost of these sustainable containers.

The restaurant lists (859) 261-6552 for questions. Posted hours are 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–8:45 p.m. Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday; the displayed schedule does not list Monday. Confirm before travelling.
